title: Package Manifest
description: A list of Debian packages to install, each with the reason it earns a slot. Read by the HomelabIaC image build and by config management.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. The validator fetches it.

packages.description: The packages to install. Names must be unique within a manifest; the HomelabIaC validator enforces that, since JSON Schema can't.

why.description: What the package is for, in one line.

version.description: Optional exact apt version; installed as name=version.
